crossRefs.note: “ ‘ “He also took some of the seed of the land, and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He…
It grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So…

translations.web: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.” ’
translations.bsb: It had been planted in good soil by abundant waters in order to yield branches and bear fruit and become a splendid vine.’
translations.kjv: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.
translations.asv: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.
